pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with sharp pixel gradients at the edges. Several patches on the mid-flank exhibit a 'starburst' internal texture where a dark central core radiates into lighter brown peripheral zones.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored lattice forming a tri-radial junction network. The negative space pathways maintain a consistent width throughout the visible flank, separating the dark polygons with high contrast.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder. The mane presents as a continuous series of dense, vertical hair clusters creating a jagged 1D geometric contour.
